_notes.metrics: Metric policies (strict full-horizon targets, exclude-and-count invalid predictions, window- and track-weighted aggregation, miss rate NOT_CONFIGURED) come from the unchanged P5.4 baseline_evaluation_default.json and the unchanged P5.4 evaluator.
_notes.primary_vs_oracle: Primary metrics use the most-probable mode (argmax of the model's probabilities). minADE@5 / minFDE@5 are best-of-K ORACLE metrics, reported separately.
_notes.sample_status: The pilot has no independent partition: the model is trained on, and evaluated on, the same windows. The comparison with the training-free classical baselines is therefore in-sample and is not evidence of superiority or generalisation.
_notes.checkpoint: 'final' = the final-epoch checkpoint recorded in the training manifest (the only selection policy; no best-checkpoint selection).
_notes.p54_reference_results_path: optional: the committed P5.4 results are used only to cross-check that the recomputed baseline ADE means are identical.
